name: Rapac Energy Ltd.
summary: Rapac Energy Ltd. initiates, develops, establish, own, manage, operate, and licenses systems for the production and sale of electricity in Israel. It operates through solar systems and power stations segments. The company was incorporate in 2021 and is based in Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut, Israel. Rapac Energy Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Rapac Communication & Infrastructure Ltd.
